'''Bodakus Emol''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] soldier of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who visited the town of [[Raider's Cove]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bodakus Emol appears as a trooper trainer in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
